hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A prediction market hook for Uniswap v4 pools (YES/NO outcome shares vs collateral). Implements VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) fees calculated as e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]-1, where σ is a per-swap toxic-velocity parameter supplied as a signed off-chain oracle message. Fees are captured from the collateral token via BeforeSwapDelta and routed to a YieldDistributor rather than to LPs.
